extraction.notes: Current-quarter (three months ended March 31, 2024) column only. FFO, Core FFO and Core AFFO subtotals all tie: -3,903 + FFO adjustments = 10,380; + core adjustments = 14,179; + AFFO adjustments = 18,334. Company has no separate AFFO metric; its AFFO is named Core AFFO and starts from Core FFO. Recurring capex is deducted in AFFO (building improvements and TI/LC lines, labeled 'non-incremental revenue generating capital expenditures'), so recurring_capex_disclosed is null. Diluted share count is not printed on the provided pages; the amount field is a placeholder 0 and should be replaced from the weighted average shares table (not provided). Judgment calls: 'Land and other impairments' is zero this quarter and was categorized re_impairment (it is non-depreciable land, so a different category could apply; amount is zero either way). 'Amortization of derivative premium' ($904) was categorized derivative_mtm; it could also be debt_cost_amortization. Market lease intangible amortization and lease inducement amortization were grouped under straight_line_rent as similar non-cash revenue items. Rebranding and severance lines were both categorized severance_restructuring.
